control_definitions.modes: Normalize Y relative displacements with the equilibrium Y–Y axis. Report the four largest lateral-projection modes per cage and select one representative lateral, longitudinal and cage-dominated mode for tensor derivatives. Projection selection precedes looking at derivatives.
control_definitions.finite_difference: For each selected mode compute +/-h and +/-h/2 at the same electronic method; hold geometry otherwise fixed.
control_definitions.orientation: Rigidly rotate one displaced/undisplaced set, rotate the tensor back with R^T T R and verify invariance. Do not finite-difference independently sorted principal values near degeneracy.
control_definitions.thermal: Use 20 K and 100 K as common comparison temperatures, with occupation and derivative contributions reported separately.

observable_definition: In a common molecule-fixed Cartesian frame, dT/dQ=[T(+h)-T(-h)]/(2h) for T=g or hyperfine A, with mass-weighted normal coordinate Q and units declared. Compare h/2. Report n=1/(exp(hc nu/kT)-1) and n(n+1) separately from the derivative-based coupling; use positive vibrational frequencies.

required_comparisons.description: Mode eigenvectors and reproducible displacement classification
Six central tensor derivatives with step control
Occupation versus coupling and rotational covariance

optional_not_scored: Full relaxation-rate integration, all modes and Gd analogues are optional.
source_note: Molecular identities, benchmark-defined starts and explicitly labelled measured observations are authorized inputs. Graph provenance identifies chemical identity only; state labels, optimized added geometries and predicted outputs are withheld. See task.md for the common scientific scope.
public_private_boundary: Identity/connectivity and declared measured observations are public. Author optimized new candidate geometries, computed rankings, reference outputs and legacy PASS archives are private.
